Delivers, in THIS worker directory only: (1) tools/epoch_view.py — one table row per GAME EPOCH (pid) from the accumulated sdiag jsonl (+ optional UE4SS mirror and runtime-status), with build_id (CLI-pinned only; the sdiag grammar carries none), session (status session row applied to its pid alone), first/last t_ms, the first-seen stage chain in the evidence.sh tag vocabulary (coarse ENTRY/ACT/VMMAP/lease/anchors/conversion/cfg/START/pad/harness/STOP AND the exact S-stage names, with the GAP-3 exepath_source display quirk annotated), the terminal event (verbatim r4 refusal line + int32 code + 0x-hex pad error decode), the predicted pair (anchor_count/intervals_found/lease_spans/lease_reg/extent/cfg/spanpub), E4-activated as literal-only-via-session-match else evidence-equivalence with caveat, buffered-Lua harness green, and the verdict class in the oracle vocabulary (E2 START / pad phase-6 / B7 MFA / engine-ready / mods-started plus D6/D7/C12/E1/STARTED) with a MINIMAL-ACCEPT-grade quartet qualifier; --json machine document; --baseline-bytes byte-exact append cut as a per-epoch NEW label with history always shown; robustness for unparseable lines, pid reuse across boots (occurrence #k), reboot detection (t_ms backwards -> BOOT-GAP note), truncated epochs (INCOMPLETE_WINDOW, never guessed), missing file (exit 2), empty input (NO-EPOCHS). (4) REPORT.md. evidence.sh (owner worker-evidence-gap-fix-2, in flight) was read for vocabulary only (canonical copy worker-launch10-evidence-upgrade/evidence.sh) and never edited. NO console contact; LOCAL file analysis only; no files outside this worker directory created or modified.

user_directive_implemented.directive: runtime-status.txt is LATEST-STATE-ONLY (last-writer-wins by design); the authoritative activation/terminal evidence is the durable per-build/run/PID events — the sdiag jsonl (accumulates across epochs) + the UE4SS mirror lines; evidence reading must correlate by build/run/pid and never race the file
mechanism: epoch facts come only from sdiag records and pid-prefixed UE4SS.log lines of that pid

the status file (when given) is parsed as one session row + last state and applied ONLY to the epoch whose pid equals the session pid; other epochs are never touched; when the session pid has no epoch in the file the tool says so instead of guessing
the old 'fetch status before terminal write' caveat is not modeled anywhere — there is no race to win
